mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT cp.id, cp.* FROM contract_project AS cp
INNER JOIN sys_project_user_link pul ON pul.project_id = cp.id AND pul.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND (pul.user_id = #{userId})
WHERE cp.bool_delete_enum = 0
and (cp.name like concat('%', #{noOrProjectName}, '%') or cp.serial_number like concat('%', #{noOrProjectName},'%'))
and cp.status = #{status}
order by cp.id desc

SELECT cp.id FROM contract_project cp INNER JOIN sys_project_user_link pul ON pul.project_id = cp.id WHERE cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND pul.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND pul.user_id = #{userId}
and cp.level & #{level} > 0
select id, serial_number, name, short_name, project_attribute, project_manager_id, contract_sign_body_id from contract_project where id = #{projectId} and bool_delete_enum = 0

select customer_unit name,business_type, ifnull(count(*),0) quantity, ifnull(sum(contract_amount),0) total_contract_amount, ifnull(sum(settlement_amount) ,0) total_settlement_amount from contract_project where bool_delete_enum = 0
and customer_unit like CONCAT('%',#{name},'%')
and business_type = #{businessType}
and date(create_time) >= date(#{startDate})
and date(create_time) <= date(#{endDate})
and id in
#{projectId}
group by customer_unit,business_type

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') AS month, business_type, COUNT( id ) AS count, sum( contract_amount ) AS contract_amount FROM contract_project WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT( create_time , '%Y' ) = DATE_FORMAT( #{dateTime} , '%Y' ) GROUP BY month, business_type

SELECT * FROM `contract_project` WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0
AND collection_amount < invoice_amount
AND settlement_status = 1 AND collection_amount < settlement_amount
order by id

SELECT COUNT(*) as able_collection_quantity,
IFNULL(SUM(invoice_amount),0) as invoice_amount, IFNULL(SUM(invoice_amount),0) - IFNULL(SUM(collection_amount),0) as able_collection_amount,
IFNULL(SUM(settlement_amount),0) as settlement_amount, IFNULL(SUM(settlement_amount),0) - IFNULL(SUM(collection_amount),0) as able_collection_amount,
IFNULL(SUM(collection_amount),0) as collection_amount, FROM contract_project WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0
AND collection_amount < invoice_amount
AND settlement_status = 1 AND collection_amount < settlement_amount

SELECT * FROM contract_project WHERE bool_delete_enum=FALSE
AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time,'%Y')=DATE_FORMAT(#{date},'%Y')
AND status=#{status}
AND project_type & 3
AND (name like concat('%',#{name},'%') or short_name like concat('%',#{name},'%') or serial_number like concat('%',#{name},'%') )
AND id in
#{projectId}
ORDER BY id DESC

select * from contract_project where bool_delete_enum=0
AND date(create_time) >= date(#{startDate})
AND date(create_time) <= date(#{endDate})
and (name like concat('%',#{name},'%') or short_name like concat('%',#{name},'%') or serial_number like concat('%',#{name},'%'))

select cp.id projectId, cp.serial_number projectCode, cp.name projectName, cp.short_name shortName, cp.create_time createTime, cp.signer_name signerName, su.name createName, cp.project_content projectContent, cp.start_date startDate, cp.end_date endDate, cp.signing_date signingDate from contract_project cp left join sys_user su on cp.user_id = su.id left join contract_tech ct on cp.id = ct.project_id where cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 and cp.status = 1 and ct.category_type = 4
and cp.id IN
#{projectId}
and (cp.short_name like concat('%', #{dto.projectName}, '%') or cp.serial_number like concat('%', #{dto.projectName},'%'))
and cp.signer_name like concat('%',#{dto.signerName},'%')
and su.name like concat('%',#{dto.createName},'%')
and date_format(cp.create_time,'%Y') = #{dto.year}
group by projectId order by cp.create_time desc
${sql}
select count(*) from project_install_report where bool_delete_enum = 0 and audit_status = 1 and project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT * FROM contract_project a WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0
AND DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time,'%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(#{yearDate},'%Y')
AND DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time,'%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(#{yearDate},'%Y%m')
AND business_type & #{businessType} > 0
AND EXISTS( select 1 from project_branch_company_link pbcl where pbcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE and pbcl.branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId} and pbcl.project_id = a.id )

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ta.create_time, '%Y-%m') as dateTime, (SUM(ta.total_net_weight)) AS deepMete FROM tech_artifact ta WHERE ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE and ta.project_id = #{projectId} group by DATE_FORMAT(ta.create_time, '%Y-%m')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mbt.create_time, '%Y-%m') as dateTime, (SUM(mbt.complete_quantity * ta.net_weight)) AS produceMete FROM mes_building_task mbt LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.id = mbt.product_id WHERE mbt.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mbt.task_type_enum = 2 and mbt.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mbt.create_time, '%Y-%m')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mbws.create_time, '%Y-%m') as dateTime, (SUM(mbws.quantity * ta.net_weight)) AS shippingMete FROM mes_building_warehouse_summary mbws LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.id = mbws.product_id WHERE mbws.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mbws.type = 2 AND mbws.product_type = 2 and mbws.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mbws.create_time, '%Y-%m')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pis.create_time, '%Y-%m') as dateTime, (SUM(pis.actual_quantity * ta.net_weight)) AS installMete FROM project_install_summary pis LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.id = pis.product_id WHERE pis.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pis.product_type = 2 and pis.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(pis.create_time, '%Y-%m')

SELECT (SUM(pis.actual_quantity * ta.net_weight) / 1000) AS installMete FROM project_install_summary pis LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.id = pis.product_id WHERE pis.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pis.product_type = 2 and pis.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT cp.*, CASE WHEN plan.plan_count IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS have_plan FROM contract_project cp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS plan_count FROM plan_monomer WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY project_id ) plan ON plan.project_id = cp.id
INNER JOIN sys_project_user_link link ON link.project_id = cp.id AND link.user_id = #{userId} AND link.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND cp.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND CASE WHEN plan.plan_count IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END = #{status}
AND DATE_FORMAT(cp.signing_date, '%Y') = #{year}
AND (cp.project_type & #{projectType}) != 0
AND (cp.lump_sum_system_type & #{lumpSumSystemType}) != 0
AND (cp.short_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{noOrName}, '%') OR cp.serial_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{noOrName}, '%'))
ORDER BY have_plan ASC, cp.create_time DESC
